text:
[NDBG.14.7.1] Traces a specific fact through the alpha nodes of the
Rete network, showing where it passed and where it was filtered. The engine
traces alpha nodes only ([NDBG.4.2]), so the response says that joins are not
traced.

Request: `{ "fact_id": "#39" }`

Response:
```json
{
  "fact": { "schema": "Sensor", "slots": { "entity_id": "bedroom", "value": 71.0 } },
  "path": [
    { "node_id": "17",
      "node_kind": "alpha",
      "result": "filtered",
      "detail": "value > 80.0 failed: value is 71.0" }
  ],
  "joins_traced": false
}
```
